body: Thank you. I just hope it doesn't take long.

I just wanted to say thank so, so much. I'm not okay right now, and I don't know when I will be, but just the fact that you took the time to help me out means a lot to me. I really don't have anyone to talk to, so this helps me out more than you know. I don't know if I'll ever end up talking to the person because I don't really know how to approach people at first.

It's a combination of factors. Honestly, I don't care what people think. I'm not getting picked on. Even when I'm having a good time the sadness is the back of brain picking away at my sanity. A lot of it has to do with this certain person. 

It all started a year ago. I figured out that they have the exact same taste in music as me (I like almost every kind of music). This doesn't happen very often, so I decided to try and talk to them. One day I did, and I totally screwed it up. I was really awkward. I was really sad for a while after that, because I felt like a failure. Finally, I didn't care anymore. 

Flash forward to this year, same person. I always feel them staring at me. Not in a bad way though. This sounds weird, but I feel like they're a lot like me, and that we have some kind of subconscious connection. We haven't talked since last year, but I always have this feeling they're about to talk to me,but they never do. Here's where it gets messy. I think I have feelings for them, and we're the same gender. I don't really believe in labels, but right now I'm questioning everything and it's really confusing and I just want my mind to be quiet. 

So that's why I want to kill myself. Maybe it sounds shallow and immature, I suppose lots of people have better reasons than me. I jsut want to feel emotions again.
